impact:
createWriteAuthority / LatchingWriteAuthority (authority.ts:74) — the AC8 guarantee that authority loss LATCHES, so publishing is irreversibly disabled even if the loss handler misbehaves — is exercised by tests (snapshot-store.test.mjs:25, 201, 205) but has no construction site in src/. Every store.ts entry point takes a bare WriteAuthority, so whether the latch is in the path depends entirely on what the caller passes.

That caller is T-011's service, which does not exist yet, so this is a deferred wiring seam rather than a defect: T-010's own acceptance is satisfied by the tested wrapper. Recording it so the wrap is not forgotten when T-011 constructs the authority — an unwrapped raw authority there would silently drop AC8's latch, and no T-010 test would notice.

NOTE for reviewers: an automated review initially called this "dead code, AC8 unsatisfied" by grepping only src/. It is not dead — the tests construct it. Verify test directories before making a reachability claim.
title: [T-010/T-011] The lock-loss latch is unit-tested but nothing in src/ constructs it
